subject: math
question: 计算 $n$ 阶行列式 $D_{n} = \left| \begin{array}{cccccc}a & b & 0 & \dots & 0 & 0\\ c & a & b & \dots & 0 & 0\\ 0 & c & a & \dots & 0 & 0\\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots & \vdots \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & a & b\\ 0 & 0 & 0 & \dots & c & a \end{array} \right|$
answer: 到行列式的递推式, 须注意选择适当的行或列来展开, 展开后的低阶行列式必须与原行列式有相同的形状, 才能保证递推式的正确.

steps.text:
分析 将行列式按第1行或第1列展开，很容易得到递推式，用递推式就可求得行列式的值. 解 将 $D_{n}$ 按第1列展开，有

$$
D _ {n} = a D _ {n - 1} - b c D _ {n - 2}.\tag{①}
$$

设 $\alpha, \beta$ 是方程 $x^{2} - ax + bc = 0$ 的两个根，则有

$$
\alpha = \frac {a + \sqrt {a ^ {2} - 4 b c}}{2}, \beta = \frac {a - \sqrt {a ^ {2} - 4 b c}}{2},
$$

且 $\alpha +\beta = a$ ， $\alpha \beta = bc$ ，将其代入①式，变形并递推得

$$
D _ {n} - \alpha D _ {n - 1} = \beta (D _ {n - 1} - \alpha D _ {n - 2}) = \beta^ {2} (D _ {n - 2} - \alpha D _ {n - 3}) = \dots = \beta^ {n - 2} (D _ {2} - \alpha D _ {1}).\tag{②}
$$

由于

$$
D _ {2} - \alpha D _ {1} = \left| \begin{array}{c c} a & b \\ c & a \end{array} \right| - \alpha a = a ^ {2} - b c - \alpha a = (\alpha + \beta) ^ {2} - \alpha \beta - \alpha (\alpha + \beta) = \beta^ {2},
$$

所以②式化简为

$$
D _ {n} - \alpha D _ {n - 1} = \beta^ {n}.\tag{③}
$$

由 $\alpha, \beta$ 的对称性，又有

$$
D _ {n} - \beta D _ {n - 1} = \alpha^ {n}.\tag{④}
$$

当 $\alpha \neq \beta$ 时，③，④式联立求解，可得

$$
D _ {n} = \frac {\alpha^ {n + 1} - \beta^ {n + 1}}{\alpha - \beta} = \frac {\left(a + \sqrt {a ^ {2} - 4 b c}\right) ^ {n + 1} - \left(a - \sqrt {a ^ {2} - 4 b c}\right) ^ {n + 1}}{2 ^ {n + 1} \sqrt {a ^ {2} - 4 b c}};
$$

当 $\alpha = \beta$ 时，即 $a^2 = 4bc$ ，由③式知

$$
\begin{array}{r l} D _ {n} & = \alpha^ {n} + \alpha D _ {n - 1} = \alpha^ {n} + \alpha (\alpha^ {n - 1} + \alpha D _ {n - 2}) = 2 \alpha^ {n} + \alpha^ {2} D _ {n - 2} = \dots \\ & = (n - 1) \alpha^ {n} + \alpha^ {n - 1} D _ {1} = (n - 1) \alpha^ {n} + \alpha^ {n - 1} \cdot 2 \alpha = (n + 1) \alpha

分析 将行列式按第1行或第1列展开，很容易得到递推式，用递推式就可求得行列式的值. 解 将 $D_{n}$ 按第1列展开，有

$$
D _ {n} = a D _ {n - 1} - b c D _ {n - 2}.\tag{①}
$$

设 $\alpha, \beta$ 是方程 $x^{2} - ax + bc = 0$ 的两个根，则有

$$
\alpha = \frac {a + \sqrt {a ^ {2} - 4 b c}}{2}, \beta = \frac {a - \sqrt {a ^ {2} - 4 b c}}{2},
$$

且 $\alpha +\beta = a$ ， $\alpha \beta = bc$ ，将其代入①式，变形并递推得

$$
D _ {n} - \alpha D _ {n - 1} = \beta (D _ {n - 1} - \alpha D _ {n - 2}) = \beta^ {2} (D _ {n - 2} - \alpha D _ {n - 3}) = \dots = \beta^ {n - 2} (D _ {2} - \alpha D _ {1}).\tag{②}
$$

由于

$$
D _ {2} - \alpha D _ {1} = \left| \begin{array}{c c} a & b \\ c & a \end{array} \right| - \alpha a = a ^ {2} - b c - \alpha a = (\alpha + \beta) ^ {2} - \alpha \beta - \alpha (\alpha + \beta) = \beta^ {2},
$$

所以②式化简为

$$
D _ {n} - \alpha D _ {n - 1} = \beta^ {n}.\tag{③}
$$

由 $\alpha, \beta$ 的对称性，又有

$$
D _ {n} - \beta D _ {n - 1} = \alpha^ {n}.\tag{④}
$$

当 $\alpha \neq \beta$ 时，③，④式联立求解，可得

$$
D _ {n} = \frac {\alpha^ {n + 1} - \beta^ {n + 1}}{\alpha - \beta} = \frac {\left(a + \sqrt {a ^ {2} - 4 b c}\right) ^ {n + 1} - \left(a - \sqrt {a ^ {2} - 4 b c}\right) ^ {n + 1}}{2 ^ {n + 1} \sqrt {a ^ {2} - 4 b c}};
$$

当 $\alpha = \beta$ 时，即 $a^2 = 4bc$ ，由③式知

$$
\begin{array}{r l} D _ {n} & = \alpha^ {n} + \alpha D _ {n - 1} = \alpha^ {n} + \alpha (\alpha^ {n - 1} + \alpha D _ {n - 2}) = 2 \alpha^ {n} + \alpha^ {2} D _ {n - 2} = \dots \\ & = (n - 1) \alpha^ {n} + \alpha^ {n - 1} D _ {1} = (n - 1) \alpha^ {n} + \alpha^ {n - 1} \cdot 2 \alpha = (n + 1) \alpha^ {n} = (n + 1) \left(\frac {a}{2}\right) ^ {n}. \end{array}
$$

$$
D _ {n} = \left\{ \begin{array}{l l} \frac {\left(a + \sqrt {a ^ {2} - 4 b c}\right) ^ {n + 1} - \left(a - \sqrt {a ^ {2} - 4 b c}\right) ^ {n + 1}}{2 ^ {n + 1} \sqrt {a ^ {2} - 4 b c}}, & a ^ {2} \neq 4 b c \\ (n + 1) \left(\frac {a}{2}\right) ^ {n}, & a ^ {2} = 4 b c \end{array} \right.
$$

评注（1）该例行列式又称为三对角线型行列式，这是一类较典型的行列式，常用的计算法是递推法或归纳法.

(2) 要得到行列式的递推式, 须注意选择适当的行或列来展开, 展开后的低阶行列式必须与原行列式有相同的形状, 才能保证递推式的正确.

（3）该行列式的递推式是一个二阶常系数线性差分方程，熟悉差分方程求解（特征根法、幂级数法）对计算行列式会有帮助.
